subject: CAIQ attestation request and test-case bank — Peregrine Health
messages:
From: Audits Team <audits@charon-audit.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ attestation and test-case bank request — Peregrine Health

Hi Jonas / Kimberly,

We're kicking off the CAIQ review for Peregrine Health (scope: production inference, hosted + dedicated). Attached is our initial ask (charon_initial_caic_request.pdf) — the questionnaire includes the CAIQ matrix and a short list of control-level test cases we expect to validate.

Two immediate asks so we can schedule sampling:
- A control-to-evidence crosswalk (spreadsheet) mapping each CAIQ control to a primary artifact and an owner.
- A small "test-case bank" of reproducible steps or log snippets we can use to verify runtime claims (examples: KV cache eviction log, a sample batch trace for an inference request, HSM rotation proof).

Please let us know: proposed delivery date for the crosswalk and whether any controls are out of scope for Peregrine Health's environment. We aim to assemble a 10-day window for remote sampling starting 2026-08-25.

Thanks,
Ava Lang
Audits Team
Charon Advisory

Attachment: charon_initial_caic_request.pdf (PDF, 1 page)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Audits Team <audits@charon-audit.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ attestation and test-case bank request — Peregrine Health

Hi Ava — thanks for the note and the attached scope. We're on it. High-level plan:

1) Deliverables by 2026-08-20:
   - CAIQ control matrix (primary artifact + owner) as a single spreadsheet.
   - Test-case bank: 8 runnable test cases with sample outputs/log snippets.

2) Owners: I'll assign owners and include them in the crosswalk; Kimberly will be the point for runtime telemetry and evidence pulls.

3) Out-of-scope clarifications: tenant-level customer data samples will be redacted; any artifacts containing PII or customer prompts will be replaced with synthetic equivalents (we'll document substitution approach in the index).

I've uploaded the initial control matrix and an evidence index for internal review — see attachments: redwood_caiq_control_matrix_v1.xlsx, evidence-index.csv. These are a draft; owners will validate the mappings by EOD 2026-08-18.

Next steps: Kimberly — can you confirm which HSM/kms rotation artifacts we can share as a sanitized sample (we plan to include a redacted rotation chronology and key-id mapping)? Also flag any controls you think need longer lead time.

Jonas Weber
Director, Compliance Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_caiq_control_matrix_v1.xlsx (XLSX, 1 sheet), evidence-index.csv (CSV, index of artifacts)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Cc: Audits Team <audits@charon-audit.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ attestation and test-case bank request — Peregrine Health

On Tue, Aug 11, 2026 at 11:05 AM Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai> wrote:
> I've uploaded the initial control matrix and an evidence index for internal review — see attachments: redwood_caiq_control_matrix_v1.xlsx, evidence-index.csv.

Thanks Jonas — tagging Marissa for any tenant-scope clarifications. A couple quick clarifications from runtime:

- HSM/KMS artifacts: we can provide a redacted rotation chronology and a sample audit entry (will redact key material and any customer identifiers). Prototype file: hsm-rotation-sample.pdf (will upload to Drive).
- Telemetry/log samples: For request traces we'll provide a synthetic prompt with the original token counts preserved and a matching llm runtime trace that shows batching and cache hits. The trace will be correlated to an internal request id pattern (we'll map the pattern in the evidence-index).
- Test-case bank: we'll include an exact playback recipe for a cache-priming scenario (steps + expected KV cache entries + snapshot of cache metrics). That will require a 3-hour lab run to extract the deterministic artifacts.

Marissa — can you confirm ETA for the lab run (I think we can schedule next week) and whether Legal needs to review the sanitized telemetry examples before they go to Charon.

Kimberly Park
Sr. Security Engineer, Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachment (planned): hsm-rotation-sample.pdf (PDF, redacted), note: PII redaction in progress.

From: Audits Team <audits@charon-audit.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@peregrinehealth.com
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 15:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ attestation and test-case bank request — Peregrine Health

Jonas / Kimberly — really helpful, thanks. A few follow-ups to lock the sampling window: 

- 2026-08-25 sampling window still looks good if we receive finalized crosswalk by 2026-08-20.
- Please include the redacted HSM rotation chronology and at least one signed attestation that confirms the rotation schedule for the last 12 months (electronic signature is fine).
- For the test-case bank, the playback recipe + expected outputs are sufficient; we do not need raw token content if you provide deterministic replay artifacts.

If you can upload the final artifacts to the Drive folder (link below) and add a short README for each artifact that lists: owner, retention window, and any substitution/redaction notes, that'll speed review.

I'll send a calendar invite for a 30-min handoff call the morning of 2026-08-26 to walk the team through the samples.

Best,
Ava Lang
Charon Advisory — Audit Lead

Drive upload link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cCAIQ-sample-bank
Requested attachments: redwood_caiq_control_matrix_final.xlsx, hsm-rotation-sample.pdf, test-case-bank-playbook.md, signed-attestation-docusign.pdf
